Groww — Week of 2026-08-24 – 2026-08-30 (ISO 2026-W35)
App performance & bugs
Lag and crashes during trading hours; login/session timeouts.
“the app freezes exactly when the market opens, very frustrating”
Action: Scale infra during market hours; improve crash visibility.
Customer support friction
Slow responses; unresolved tickets.
“support takes days to reply and doesn't solve the issue”
Action: Expected response time in-app; ticket status tracking.
Who this helps
Product: Prioritize roadmap from recurring themes
Support: Spot repeating complaints and quality issues
Leadership: Fast health snapshot tied to customer voice
